Appearance

About this guide

A Malaysian field reference for PPKA, public health practitioners, Medical Officers, PPKP, PKP, PKA and district response teams.

CD-Made-Easy brings existing disease guidance, field calculations, POA, legal references and guideline reviews into one working reference.

POA entries are saved in this browser. Use the POA backup function to keep a copy or move records between devices.

UI build 2026.10.21.3. Source review date recorded in the existing guide: 20 Oct 2026. Dengue simulation and visual surveillance summaries refined on 20 Oct 2026. Synthetic observations are labelled; full original guidance, source caveats and calculators are retained. This public feedback release groups calculators by disease, adds responsive navigation and feedback, removes private document links and embedded achievement notes, and retains a POA workspace with no supplied records or activities. The background is decorative, not surveillance data.

How to use this guide
  • Use a quick action or choose a disease category.
  • Search English or Bahasa Malaysia names, abbreviations, actions, tools and source titles. On a keyboard, press Down or Enter to focus the first result; Escape clears search.
  • Switch between Grid and List. Enable BM names & source notes for additional context.
  • Open a guide's sections for complete definitions, notification requirements, control guidance and citations.
  • In Tools, choose a disease, select a calculator and enter the required inputs.
  • Check calculator anchors and caveats. These tools do not issue orders or certify outbreak closure.
  • POA starts without supplied achievement records. Entries remain in your browser. Back up local records from the POA workspace.
Disclaimer & attribution

This application is an independent working reference, not an official KKM publication or a substitute for professional judgement. Current KKM, JKN and PKD instructions take precedence.

Use the disease-specific source and current programme instructions. Confirm applicable guidance, legal powers and unresolved issues before acting.

Referenced guidelines, source documents, illustrations and third-party materials remain the property of their respective owners.
